lines.text: The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the water spout!
How can a tiny spider walk up smooth metal and glass without falling?
Down came the rain and washed the spider out!
Under a microscope, each spider foot has hundreds of thousands of tiny hairs!
These hair tips grab onto invisible microscopic bumps on the smoothest walls!
Out came the sun and dried up all the rain!
And the itsy bitsy spider climbed up the spout again with super sticky feet!
Now you know the real superpower behind the Itsy Bitsy Spider!
